---
format:
  typst:
    fontsize: 10pt
    margin:
      x: 0.9in
      y: 0.9in
execute:
  echo: false
params:
  # The two typings, as GL Strings (hct_match_report() converts a typing given
  # by locus). Nothing here identifies a person.
  recipient: "HLA-A*02:01+HLA-A*24:02^HLA-B*07:02+HLA-B*44:02^HLA-C*07:02+HLA-C*05:01^HLA-DRB1*15:01+HLA-DRB1*04:01^HLA-DQB1*06:02+HLA-DQB1*03:02^HLA-DPB1*04:01+HLA-DPB1*02:01"
  donor: "HLA-A*02:09+HLA-A*24:02^HLA-B*07:02+HLA-B*44:02^HLA-C*07:50+HLA-C*05:01^HLA-DRB1*15:01+HLA-DRB1*04:01^HLA-DQB1*06:02+HLA-DQB1*03:02^HLA-DPB1*04:01+HLA-DPB1*02:01"
  # Printed on the report only; never sent to either service.
  recipient_label: "Recipient"
  donor_label: "Donor"
  # Match direction ("bidirectional", "GvH", or "HvG") and, for bidirectional,
  # scope ("locus" or "genotype"). See R/hct_match.R.
  direction: "bidirectional"
  scope: "locus"
  api_host: "https://api.immunogenetr.org"
  report_version: "0.2.0"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(immunogenetr)
library(tinytable)

source("R/matching_api_client.R")
source("R/hct_match.R")

# tinytable does not expose table cell padding, so the tables use this
# finalize() helper to inject a Typst `inset` (cell padding, in pt).
tt_pad <- function(x = 5, y = 2) {
  ins <- function(s) sub(
    "rows: auto,",
    sprintf("rows: auto,\n    inset: (x: %gpt, y: %gpt),", x, y),
    s, fixed = TRUE
  )
  function(tbl) {
    if (is.character(tbl)) return(ins(tbl))
    if (isS4(tbl) && .hasSlot(tbl, "table_string")) {
      tbl@table_string <- ins(tbl@table_string)
      tbl
    } else tbl
  }
}

# Text that goes into raw Typst blocks (the labels and the versions): escape everything Typst
# could read as markup, so a label cannot break the compile.
typst_text <- function(x) str_replace_all(replace_na(x, ""), "([\\\\#$*_`<>@\\[\\]=~/\"+-])", "\\\\\\1")
```

```{r matching, include=FALSE}
# All of the matching: per-locus mismatch counts, DPB1 permissiveness, and the
# X/10 and X/8 match grades. See R/hct_match.R. Quarto reports a failed chunk only as
# "error running quarto", so save the real reason where hct_match_report() can
# find it and show it.
tryCatch({
  recipient <- read_typing(params$recipient)
  donor     <- read_typing(params$donor)
  match     <- hct_match(recipient, donor, params$api_host, params$direction, params$scope)
}, error = \(e) {
  writeLines(conditionMessage(e), "render_error.txt")
  stop(e)
})
comments <- hct_comments(match)

report_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y") |> str_replace(" 0", " ")

# The API reports the IPD-IMGT/HLA release as a number (e.g. "3650"); print it
# as the release is named ("3.65.0").
ipd_imgt_hla_release <- str_replace(match$versions$ipd_imgt_hla, "^(\\d)(\\d{2})(\\d)$", "\\1.\\2.\\3")
```

```{r typing table data, include=FALSE}
# Two rows of typing for one person. A name with more than two fields gets a
# zero-width space (U+200B) after the second field so Typst can wrap it inside
# its column; it prints as nothing.
typing_rows <- function(typing, label) {
  cell <- function(locus, i) {
    x <- typing$alleles[[locus]][i]
    if (is.na(x)) "" else str_replace(x, "^([^:]+:[^:]+:)", "\\1\u200b")
  }
  map(set_names(report_loci, str_remove(report_loci, "^HLA-")),
      \(l) c(cell(l, 1), cell(l, 2))) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    add_column(Case = c(label, ""), .before = 1)
}

# One row of mismatch results. Only mismatches appear; a matched locus is left
# blank.
#   A to DPA1: 1 or 2, the count in the chosen direction at the P group level.
#   DPB1: P (permissive) or NP (non-permissive) by TCE group.
#   NC  - not compared (typing missing or not high resolution; see comments)
#   ERR - could not be compared (see comments)
# NC and ERR are printed so that a blank always means "compared, and matched".
mismatch_row <- function() {
  cell <- match$loci |>
    mutate(cell = case_when(
      !comparable   ~ "NC",
      !is.na(error) ~ "ERR",
      MM == 0       ~ "",
      .default = as.character(MM))) |>
    select(locus, cell) |>
    deframe()

  # A mismatched DPB1 shows its TCE label in place of the count.
  if (!is.null(match$tce)) {
    cell[["HLA-DPB1"]] <- if (is.na(match$tce$label)) "ERR" else match$tce$label
  }

  cell[report_loci] |>
    set_names(str_remove(report_loci, "^HLA-")) |>
    as.list() |>
    as_tibble() |>
    add_column(Case = "Mismatches", .before = 1)
}

typing_data <- bind_rows(
  typing_rows(recipient, params$recipient_label),
  typing_rows(donor, params$donor_label),
  mismatch_row()
)

# The reason for a missing grade is in the comments, not on this line: this
# line goes into a raw Typst block, where an API message could break the compile.
grade_text <- function(match_grade) {
  g      <- match$grades[[match_grade]]$grade
  out_of <- grade_out_of[[match_grade]]
  str_c(if (is.na(g)) str_c("X/", out_of, " not calculated") else str_c(g, "/", out_of),
        " (", str_flatten_comma(str_remove(grade_loci[[match_grade]], "^HLA-")), ")")
}
grades_text <- str_c(str_flatten(map_chr(names(grade_loci), grade_text), "; "),
                     if (any(map_lgl(match$grades, \(g) is.na(g$grade)))) "; see comments" else "")

# The matching options in words, for the note under the table and the grades.
direction_text <- switch(match$direction,
  bidirectional = "Bidirectional",
  GvH           = "Graft-versus-host (GvH)",
  HvG           = "Host-versus-graft (HvG)")
scope_text <- if (match$direction != "bidirectional") "" else switch(match$scope,
  locus    = " Scope: locus (the worse direction at each locus, added up).",
  genotype = " Scope: genotype (the worse of the GvH and HvG totals).")
```

```{=typst}
// A sans-serif font that is likely to be installed; Typst falls back to its
// own font when none of these is present.
#set text(font: ("Arial", "Helvetica", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"))
// No hyphenation or justification: they split and stretch labels in table cells.
#set text(hyphenate: false)
#set par(justify: false)
// Page header. A Typst page rule applies only from where it appears, so this
// block must come before any content.
#set page(header: [
  HCT donor match report #h(1fr) `r report_date`
  #line(length: 100%)
])
#align(center)[#text(14pt)[*HCT Donor Match Report*]]
#v(4pt)
*Recipient:* `r typst_text(params$recipient_label)` #h(2em) *Donor:* `r typst_text(params$donor_label)`
#v(6pt)
#align(center)[#text(size: 11pt, weight: "bold")[Typing]]
```

```{r typing table}
colnames(typing_data)[1] <- ""

# format_tt(escape = TRUE) escapes Typst special characters in the cells, so an
# unexpected character in a label or allele name cannot stop the compile.
tt(typing_data, width = c(.13, rep(.87 / 8, 8))) |>
  format_tt(escape = TRUE) |>
  style_tt(j = 1:9, align = "l", fontsize = 0.9) |>
  style_tt(i = 0, line = "b", line_color = "black", line_width = 0.1) |>
  style_tt(i = c(2, 4), line = "b", line_color = "black", line_width = 0.1) |>
  style_tt(i = 5, bold = TRUE) |>
  style_tt(finalize = tt_pad(x = 4, y = 5))
```

```{=typst}
#text(9pt)[`r direction_text` mismatch counts are calculated for A, B, C, DRB1, DQA1, DQB1, and DPA1 after reduction of both typings to P groups. A homozygous mismatch counts as 2. A DPB1 mismatch is shown as P (permissive) or NP (non-permissive) by T-cell epitope group. A matched locus is left blank. NC: not compared. ERR: could not be compared.]
#v(10pt)
#text(12pt)[*HLA match grade, P group level: `r grades_text`*]
#v(2pt)
#text(9pt)[Direction: `r direction_text`.`r scope_text` DQA1, DPA1, and DPB1 are not part of either grade.]
#v(8pt)
#text(10pt)[*Genotypes matched* (after py-ard reduction to P groups; loci marked NC or ERR are not included)]
```

```{r reduced genotypes}
# What was actually matched: each person's genotype as py-ard reduced it, as a
# GL String. A GL String has no spaces, so a zero-width space (U+200B) after
# each "^" and "+" lets Typst wrap it; it prints as nothing.
reduced <- hct_reduced_gl(match)
wrap_gl <- function(gl) if (is.na(gl)) "No locus was compared." else str_replace_all(gl, "([\\^+])", "\\1\u200b")
tibble(Person = c(params$recipient_label, params$donor_label),
       Genotype = c(wrap_gl(reduced$recipient), wrap_gl(reduced$donor))) |>
  tt(width = c(.22, .78), colnames = FALSE) |>
  format_tt(escape = TRUE) |>
  style_tt(j = 1:2, align = "l", fontsize = 0.9) |>
  style_tt(finalize = tt_pad(x = 4, y = 3))
```

```{=typst}
#v(8pt)
#align(center)[#text(size: 11pt, weight: "bold")[Comments]]
```

```{r comments table}
# One comment per row, in a table so format_tt(escape = TRUE) can make allele
# names and API messages safe for Typst. tt() rejects a zero-row data frame, so
# a report with nothing to say gets an explicit line saying that.
tibble(Comment = if (length(comments) == 0) {
  "P group reduction did not change any mismatch count or either match grade."
} else {
  comments
}) |>
  tt(width = 1, colnames = FALSE) |>
  format_tt(escape = TRUE) |>
  style_tt(j = 1, align = "l", fontsize = 0.9) |>
  style_tt(finalize = tt_pad(x = 5, y = 3))
```
